note: This directory holds two kinds of file and only one of them is recorded here. The entries below are byte-identical copies of contracts GMM owns; everything else in the directory is produced HERE by scripts/ and is not a copy of anything (lekyn-owner-batches.json, lekyn-uat-evidence.json, uat-scenario-matrix.json, lekyn-rag-ab-evidence.json). Those are covered by their own regeneration tests, which compare the committed file against a fresh run.

lekyn-dossier.example.json.why_it_is_copied: Both artefacts are rendered from this dossier here, and a test may not read a sibling checkout. GMM owns the evidence model, its schema and this example; this is the consumer's copy.
lekyn-dossier.example.json.checked_here: the digest, against the bytes in this repository
lekyn-dossier.example.json.not_checked_here: that GMM still holds these bytes. That needs both checkouts; GMM's validate_evidence_copy_freshness.py does it when the workspace has them, and names it unchecked when it does not.

lekyn-cpr-projection.example.json.why_it_is_copied: The expected CPR projection for the dossier above, owned by the same contract.
lekyn-cpr-projection.example.json.checked_here: the digest, against the bytes in this repository
lekyn-cpr-projection.example.json.not_checked_here: that GMM still holds these bytes.
